verdict.rationale: The chip's own design and firmware are not shown as open source. Parts of the companion AI software stack are: AMD describes the Lemonade SDK as open-source and GAIA as its open-source agent framework, with GAIA's README hosted on GitHub. missing for 10: open-source chip design or firmware, an evidenced license for the core Ryzen AI Software, Vitis AI EP and NPU drivers, the specific license terms for Lemonade/GAIA, and independent corroboration.
